title: Distribution and shareholder records
audience: BBNC shareholders checking the next distribution or updating address and banking records.
rule: Shareholders on record by August 15, 2026 are scheduled to receive the September 4, 2026 distribution.
deadline: Update address or banking information before the August 15, 2026 record date.
preparation: Confirm your current mailing address and banking details before leaving this concept.
Have your myBBNC sign-in method ready; do not enter it here.
Use Shareholder Services if an online record cannot be corrected.

title: Shareholder forms and stock wills
audience: BBNC shareholders who need a form, stock will, address change, direct deposit, gift-of-stock, estate, or probate service.
rule: Form requirements vary by request; BBNC directs shareholders to its Shareholder Forms service and myBBNC portal.
deadline: There is no single deadline. Follow the date and notarization rules on the form you select.
preparation: Name the change or service you need before opening the forms library.
Gather only the supporting documents listed by the official form.
Contact Shareholder Services before sending anything you are unsure about.
ownerSystem: myBBNC forms and BBNC Shareholder Services
fallback: BBNC Shareholder Services: 907-278-3602 or 800-426-3602 toll free.

title: Descendant and missed-enrollee applications
audience: Eligible lineal descendants of original BBNC shareholders and eligible people who missed original enrollment.
rule: Class D applicants must be lineal descendants born after December 18, 1971 and not enrolled with descendant stock in another regional Alaska Native corporation. Separate Class C missed-enrollee rules apply.
deadline: Applications are open. BBNC currently publishes no closing date on the enrollment page.
preparation: Class D: birth certificate showing the lineal relationship and Social Security card.
For a minor: the child’s documents and a signed, notarized custodial consent form.
Class C: birth certificate, Social Security card, and Certificate of Indian Blood.
fallback: BBNC Enrollment: descendants@bbnc.net or 907-278-3602; paper applications are available on request.

title: Jobs, training, and scholarships
audience: BBNC shareholders, spouses, and descendants looking for employment, training, internships, or education support.
rule: Eligibility and dates are program-specific. BBNC publishes current training and development routes and directs scholarship seekers to the Bristol Bay Foundation.
deadline: Check the live opportunity before preparing an application; there is no single portfolio-wide deadline.
preparation: Identify whether you need a job, skills training, internship, or education funding.
Prepare a current resume or Talent Bank profile when the program requests one.
Confirm shareholder, spouse, descendant, age, and program-specific eligibility.
ownerSystem: BBNC Shareholder Development and Bristol Bay Foundation

handoff.label: Review current training and development routes

fallback: BBNC Shareholder Development: call 907-278-3602 and ask for the program owner.

title: Proxy, ballot, and annual meeting
audience: BBNC shareholders preparing to vote a proxy or ballot or attend the 2026 annual meeting.
rule: Completed proxies must reach Hutchings & Associates by September 30, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Alaska time. Separate day-of-meeting ballot windows apply on October 3.
deadline: Proxy deadline: September 30, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Alaska time. Annual meeting: October 3, 2026.
preparation: Locate the PIN from the mailed or emailed proxy material.
Have the last four digits of your Social Security number ready for BBNCVote only.
If the PIN is missing, use the official PIN lookup or contact the election certifier.

title: Local and human assistance
audience: Shareholders and family members who want help from a person with applications, forms, or community resources.
rule: BBNC lists Village Resource Specialists in Naknek, New Stuyahok, Nondalton, and Togiak and provides central Shareholder Services by phone.
deadline: No single deadline. Contact the department early when another task has a due date.
preparation: Write down the task, deadline, and the point where you are stuck.
Bring only the documents the specialist asks for.
Do not send sensitive records to this concept site.
ownerSystem: BBNC Shareholder Services and Village Resource Specialists
fallback: BBNC Shareholder Services: 907-278-3602 or 800-426-3602 toll free.
